name: Jack Hannigan
description:
My character was involved in a catastrophic accident a few years ago that left him critically injured. Large portions of his body had to be rebuilt with cybernetics, and the trauma left a permanent gap in his memory. He remembers his life clearly before the incident and remembers waking up in the hospital afterward, but roughly ten minutes surrounding the accident are completely missing.

No matter how hard he tries, those minutes are just gone.

Lately, though, he's started experiencing brief flashes of memory—fragments of sounds, faces, conversations, and places that seem connected to the accident. At first they appear random and meaningless, but as more pieces surface, it becomes clear that something significant happened during those missing ten minutes. Something important enough that the truth has stayed buried up to now.
drive: Figure out what happened in the hole in my memories
